ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE CERTIFICATE

Master AI. Drive Business Transformation. No Coding Required.

OFFERED BY THE SCHOOL OF TECHNOLOGY

Our Artificial Intelligence Certificate transforms business professionals into AI-capable leaders—no coding required. We cut through technical complexity to deliver practical business applications that solve real problems. With flexible formats and stackable credits, we’ve removed every barrier between you and career advancement in the AI economy.

Begin Your Journey
Request Info

What You'll Learn

Our AI curriculum focuses on practical business applications without requiring technical coding skills:

BUS 2951 – Principles of Business: Build a solid foundation in business fundamentals across all functional areas.

AI 4000 – AI Fundamentals: Understand core AI technologies and their transformative potential across industries.

AI 4001 – Introduction to Prompt Engineering in Business: Master the art of creating effective AI prompts to solve real business challenges.

AI 4002 – Introduction to AI-Driven Strategic Decision-Making: Learn to leverage AI tools for data analysis, trend prediction, and informed strategic decisions.

AI 4003 – Introduction to AI-Driven Transformation: Discover how to implement AI solutions to enhance efficiency and innovation.

AI 4004 – Introduction to AI for Customer Relationship Management: Apply AI to improve customer engagement, personalize marketing, and deliver better service.

Apply Now
 

Program Overview: 

Complete this security-focused certificate in just 6 months through 3 eight-week sessions.
  • Core Courses: 6 total (18 credit hours)
  • Format: Fully Online or Hybrid

 Pacing:

2 courses per 8-week session → complete in just 6 months

Affordable Investment:

  • Per Credit Hour: $585
  • Total Tuition: $10,530

Accreditation:

  • DEAC - Accredited
"At CalMU, we designed the AI Certificate Program for professionals who are ready to move from understanding artificial intelligence to actually deploying it. In just six months, students develop the strategic fluency and hands-on skills — from prompt engineering to AI-driven decision-making — that today's employers are actively seeking. This program isn't about keeping up with change. It's about leading it.” 
 
– Dr. Ralynn Ernest, Vice President of Academics, California Miramar University

In today’s hyperconnected world

Artificial Intelligence is revolutionizing industries—from marketing and finance to healthcare and logistics. Businesses are increasingly relying on AI tools to enhance decision-making, personalize customer experiences, and drive operational efficiency.

CalMU’s AI Certificate program prepares students to meet this demand with practical skills in prompt engineering, strategic decision-making, and AI implementation. Whether you’re starting your journey or upskilling for the future, this program offers the applied knowledge and business foundation you need to thrive in a tech-driven world.

Online Learning

Our 100% online option delivers the same comprehensive cybersecurity curriculum with maximum flexibility for working professionals. Students learn essential security concepts, threat analysis, and defense strategies while completing their coursework remotely.

Education Pathways

Artificial Intelligence Certificate

Complete this career-focused AI certificate in just 6 months through 3 eight-week sessions.

In this program, you'll master practical AI business applications without requiring coding skills, learning to leverage AI tools for strategic decision-making, business transformation, and customer engagement.

To earn your certificate, complete all 6 required courses (18 credit hours).

Highlights

- Complete in just 6 months

- No coding background required

- Immediate business applications

Bachelor of Business Administration in AI

Apply all 18 certificate credits directly toward your Bachelor of Business Administration degree with a concentration in Artificial Intelligence.

Continue your education journey seamlessly, building on your certificate foundation to earn a full degree without losing time or credits.

Highlights

- Fully stackable credits

- Same faculty and learning approach

- Enhanced career opportunities in security leadership

 

 

Advance your career!

Join our graduates who have secured promotions, raises, and leadership positions.
